graders.name: no-user-story
graders.why: The issue states the requirement instead of an "As a user, I want" story.

graders.name: at-most-five-criteria
graders.why: An acceptance-criteria list, when present, holds five items or fewer.

graders.name: under-length
graders.why: The issue stays at or under 200 prose words, the feature-request ceiling. Code blocks and Markdown symbols do not count.

graders.name: no-ai-tells
graders.pattern: (?i)—|\b(robust|seamless|powerful|crucial|pivotal|delves?|leverages?|streamlines?|journey|landscape)\b|worth noting|here['’]s the thing|at its core|(?:it|this|that)['’]s not (?:just |only )?[^,;.]{1,40}[,;] (?:it|this|that)['’]s|not only [^.;]{1,60}but also
graders.why: No em dashes, inflated vocabulary, or tell phrases.

judge.name: accurate_requirements
judge.description: The issue states every supplied requirement and invents none. Answer yes only if it covers the CSV export, all seven fields, the list filters, emailed links above 10,000 rows, ISO 8601 dates, and the Billing Admin restriction, and adds no requirement, field, or role the request did not give.
